explication: fount is a modular AI-agent runtime: users interact through chat, which resolves a character and its configured parts, builds a prompt, calls an AI source, and processes plugin reply handlers. The wider product also provides part management, social/file-sharing features, service integrations, importing, exports, and terminal/server interfaces. The principal workflow is grounded in the excerpts; several capability branches are documented in the README but their internal wiring was not sampled.
